daily.today_energy: Mercury's vibes are hitting different today. You're in your analytical era, but don't forget to let loose a little. Trust your gut feeling—it's been spot on lately.
daily.love: If you're coupled up, small gestures matter more than grand ones rn. Single? Someone's been lowkey noticing your energy. Keep being authentically you.
daily.career: Your attention to detail is literally your superpower today. That project you've been perfecting? It's ready. Put it out there and watch what happens.
daily.health: Your body's asking for grounding energy—maybe a walk, some water, or just sitting with your thoughts. Listen to what feels nourishing, not what sounds productive.

weekly.overview: This week's energy invites you to soften your perfectionist edges, Virgo. Mercury's influence suggests meaningful conversations and unexpected connections. Trust the unfolding—some of the best things don't come with checklists.
weekly.love: Someone might surprise you with genuine vulnerability this week. Whether single or coupled, the cosmos encourages you to let people in without over-analyzing their intentions first. Real connection happens when you stop fact-checking feelings.
weekly.career: Your attention to detail is still your superpower, but this week rewards you for big-picture thinking too. That project you've been hesitant about? The energy suggests taking the leap. Your instincts know more than your overthinking mind.
weekly.health: Your nervous system could use some intentional downtime. This week, prioritize rest as fuel rather than lost productivity. Even small rituals—tea, walks, journaling—act as powerful reset buttons. Listen when your body whispers before it has to shout.
